description: This file contains initialization and memory management functions for an audio processing bundle, including setting up modules like concert sound, bass enhancement, equalizer, and spectrum analyzer, with detailed memory allocation and configuration handling.

methods.name: LVM_GetMemoryTable
methods.description: Calculates and returns the memory requirements and allocations for the audio processing bundle based on instance parameters.

methods.name: LVM_GetInstanceHandle
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new instance handle for the audio processing bundle, setting up internal buffers and default parameters.

methods.name: LVM_ClearAudioBuffers
methods.description: Resets internal audio buffers of the bundle instance to clear previous data.
